s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive facial swelling and sinus pressure with nasal septum deviation and proptosis
salient_findings: Heterogeneous mass in the left maxillary sinus with solid and cystic components
key_facts: Several months of sinus pressure and facial swelling
Several weeks of external deviation of the nasal septum
No significant past medical history
Left nasal mass on examination
Mild left-sided proptosis
CT scan showed a heterogeneous mass in the left maxillary sinus
Mass eroded the orbital floor, medial and posterior maxillary walls, and anterior ethmoid air cells
Displacement of inferior rectus without muscle invasion
Left maxillary alveolar ridge and several molar roots involved
Bony changes showed remodeling and thinning
Biopsy showed spindle cell process with significant multinucleated giant cells
Rare mitotic activity
No cytologic atypia

shortlist.label: sinonasal schwannoma with new bone formation
shortlist.why_kept: matches clinical presentation of nasal mass and sinus pressure with bony changes

shortlist.label: solitary fibrous tumor
shortlist.why_kept: consistent with spindle cell process and bony remodeling on biopsy and imaging

shortlist.label: squamous cell carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: possible cause of nasal mass and erosion of surrounding structures

shortlist.label: sinusitis
shortlist.why_kept: could contribute to sinus pressure and facial swelling, although less likely given biopsy results

shortlist.label: mucormycosis
shortlist.why_kept: rare but serious infection that could cause similar symptoms, especially with nasal septum deviation and proptosis

raw.champion: sinonasal schwannoma with new bone formation
raw.rationale: The presence of a heterogeneous mass in the left maxillary sinus with bony changes showing remodeling and thinning, along with biopsy results indicating a spindle cell process and significant multinucleated giant cells, supports this diagnosis

rejected.label: solitary fibrous tumor
rejected.why: Lack of specific diagnostic features in the biopsy results

rejected.label: squamous cell carcinoma
rejected.why: No cytologic atypia or significant mitotic activity reported

rejected.label: sinusitis
rejected.why: Presence of a distinct mass and bony erosion not typical of sinusitis

rejected.label: mucormycosis
rejected.why: Clinical presentation and biopsy results do not suggest an infectious process
